title: 12-name watchlist · 3 November 2026, 22:00 SGT
summary: Nine names were higher and three lower in individually timestamped premarket observations before 22:00 SGT. AMD led at +4.30%, followed by Micron at +4.13%; Apple was weakest at −4.45%. These are separate snapshots, not simultaneous quotes or completed regular-session returns. The 2 November regular-session closes and all six return baselines were rechecked and remain unchanged.
coverage_note: Complete 12-name price and six-horizon return snapshot. New research in the 20:00–22:00 SGT window is a Reuters market-reaction update for Apple, NVIDIA and AMD, not a newly verified issuer earnings or guidance release. Previously published sourced notes and upcoming-event notices are retained with their original dates. Narrative coverage is partial; no new item verified is not evidence of no news.
price_basis: Regular-session closes: 2 November 2026, 16:00 EST (3 November, 05:00 SGT). Daily changes compare with the 30 October regular close. Separate 3 November premarket snapshots were timestamped 08:31–08:59 EST (21:31–21:59 SGT), before the 22:00 SGT cutoff. They are not exact 22:00 quotes and are not live. Source labels these quotes real-time; this report is a saved snapshot. All prices USD; TSM is the US-listed ADR.
return_basis: Cumulative return = 100*(2 November 2026 adjusted close / baseline adjusted close - 1). Baselines are 1–6 calendar months before 2 November, using the preceding trading session for non-trading anniversaries. Adjusted-close columns are checked from Stock Analysis and Yahoo Finance, with Quiver Quantitative for AMD and BRK.B; exact source URLs are attached to each baseline. These figures account for the selected vendor series adjustments and are before fees and taxes.
caveats: Premarket observations are individually timestamped, not synchronized exact-cutoff prices. AMD later displayed 09:05 EST (after the cutoff); that later value was excluded in favor of its previously observed 08:38 EST snapshot.

Yahoo direct page requests returned HTTP 429; its search-indexed historical table rows, including French and Hong Kong variants, were used where direct retrieval failed. The relevant baseline values matched the prior same-day edition.

TSM September 2 adjusted close remains 414.39 in Yahoo, versus 414.62 in Stock Analysis. Yahoo is used consistently for TSM historical dividend-adjusted baselines (its October 2 value is 472.78 in both).
Stale Canadian Yahoo and Quiver dividend-adjusted AVGO/TSM values were not substituted for the current Yahoo series. Quiver is used only for AMD and BRK.B baselines here.

Research distinguishes new in-window reporting from retained earlier notes. Reuters price observations at 20:07 SGT, published at 20:34 SGT, precede the separate later quote snapshots on the company cards.

Micron and Broadcom investor-relations pages were unavailable during the research check; Meta coverage was partial and some Reuters syndication pages were inaccessible. No complete company-news census is claimed.
Existing attributed NVIDIA/Financial Times reporting remains unconfirmed as originally qualified. Earlier event notices are retained without presenting them as newly announced developments.
Watch only: no holding, executed transaction, user buy call or investment recommendation is implied. Public sources only; no private diary entries or restricted screenshots are included.

rows.name: Apple

research.headline: New in-window market update: Apple remained under pressure
facts: Reuters’ 12:34 GMT (20:34 SGT) update reported Apple down 3.9% at 12:07 UTC (20:07 SGT), with memory costs and margin concerns in focus. That observation is earlier than the separately timestamped price snapshot in this edition.
research.analysis: This updates the market reaction to an existing concern; it does not establish a new issuer guidance announcement or prove that one factor explains the entire move.
research.risks: Different quote times can produce different percentages. Premarket liquidity and volatility can amplify movements before the regular session.
research.next_watch: The US regular-session opening and subsequent issuer disclosures on input costs and gross margins.

sources.title: Reuters via MarketScreener · 3 November 2026, 12:34 GMT market update

research.headline: Memory costs and margins are the immediate focus
facts: Reuters reported Apple weakness in premarket trading following a warning about memory costs and margins. Its 18:49 SGT report observed a 4.5% decline; that observation predates the separately timestamped quote above.
research.analysis: Margin pressure is a different question from revenue growth. Read the issuer’s underlying disclosures before attributing the whole price move to a single cause.
research.risks: Premarket pricing can change quickly and may reflect thin liquidity. The reported move is a snapshot, not a return for the regular session.
research.next_watch: Updated company guidance, memory input costs and gross-margin commentary. No additional issuer release is asserted here.

research.headline: New in-window market update: NVIDIA traded higher
facts: Reuters’ 12:34 GMT (20:34 SGT) update recorded NVIDIA up 1.4% at 12:07 UTC (20:07 SGT). This is an earlier market observation, not the later quote snapshot on this card.
research.analysis: A premarket rebound alone does not verify changes to earnings expectations or resolve the separately attributed China-exposure report retained below.

research.next_watch: Company clarification of attributed reporting and the previously announced fiscal Q3 results call.

sources.title: Reuters via MarketScreener · 3 November 2026, 12:34 GMT market update

research.headline: China-exposure report remains attributed and unconfirmed
facts: Reuters relayed a Financial Times report that NVIDIA had advised data-centre partners to reduce China exposure. Reuters said it could not independently verify the report.
research.analysis: Treat this as an attributed report, not a confirmed change in company policy or a measured earnings impact.
research.risks: The original account was not independently verified by Reuters. Customer, export-control and geographic risks require separate primary evidence.
research.next_watch: Company confirmation or clarification and any specific disclosed customer impact.

research.next_watch: The release and written CFO commentary before the call, then management’s discussion.

facts: Reuters’ 12:34 GMT (20:34 SGT) update recorded AMD up 1.8% at 12:07 UTC (20:07 SGT), before the later separately timestamped quote in this edition.
research.analysis: This is a pre-results price reaction, not evidence of an earnings beat or new guidance. The official results-call notice remains the relevant upcoming event.

research.next_watch: AMD’s official results release after the US close on 3 November and conference call on 4 November at 06:00 SGT, as stated in the retained 6 October notice.

research.risks: An event date is not evidence of better or worse earnings. Post-release prices may differ sharply from this snapshot.
research.next_watch: Read the earnings release and call on 4 November, 06:00 SGT. Separate reported results, guidance and market reaction.
